headline: Discussion on adding 'education' to the mission statement, IT updates on the software working group, and vote on 2027 meeting calendar.
summary: The agenda includes a discussion on adding 'education' to the mission statement. It also includes an IT update on the software working group and a vote on the 2027 meeting calendar.
